# IngestedFilePage

One page of a partition's files, newest first. Pass `nextCursor` back as `cursor` for the next page.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `items` | [`IngestedFileListItem`](ingested-file-list-item.md)`[]` | The files on this page. |
| `nextCursor` | `string \| null` | The cursor for the next page, passed back as it is; null on the last page. |
